messages:
Nina (Design): quick heads-up from the playtest: the Playground's function preview panel looks great but keyboard users get stuck. Tab lands on the Close X and won't get into the tool list.
Omar (A11y): that matches a focus-lock pattern. we should allow focus into the panel body and implement a roving focus for the tool items. also need semantic roles for screen readers.
Lina (Frontend): agree. plan: set initialFocus to the tool-list container instead of the close button, add role=listbox to the list, role=option to items, and aria-activedescendant for arrow navigation.
Chris (DevEx): any mobile constraints? last time autofocus opened keyboard and hid content.
Tess (PM): product note: keep preview lightweight. on narrow viewports, defer autofocus — present as bottom sheet and require an explicit tap to focus the list.
Omar (A11y): add an sr-only hint like: "Use Tab to enter the tools list; use Arrow keys to move; Enter to run." link it with aria-describedby on the panel header. ensure Esc closes the panel and focus returns to the invoking function.
Nina (Design): copy suggestion for visible header: "Invocation preview" with a tiny info icon. the full keyboard sentence should be sr-only. icon reveals a short tooltip on hover/focus.
Lina (Frontend): will add an icon-button with aria-describedby and keep the full instruction in .sr-only. will also include a Storybook story showing keyboard-only flow.
Chris (DevEx): rollout sequence: small PR to change initialFocus + roles, QA keyboard pass, experimental flag behind FF so we can test in a11y lab.
CI-Bot: created e2e checks PLG-KEY-77 (panel focus order) and PLG-KEY-78 (roving list navigation).
Nina (Design): other tiny nit: run-history rows break function names mid-word and look clumsy. prefer ellipsis at word boundary+tooltip with full name.
Lina (Frontend): will switch to text-overflow: ellipsis and add title attribute + compact detail popover on hover/focus.
Chris (DevEx): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/playground/pull/689 — assigning @Lina and @Omar for review. aiming for canary behind flag next week.
Omar (A11y): checklist for PR description please: focus order, aria roles, escape & return-focus behavior, mobile bottom-sheet behavior, screen reader announcements. i can validate in the lab after merge.
Tess (PM): prioritize keyboard & SR fixes; run-history truncation can follow if timeline is tight.
Nina (Design): thanks team. ping me for micro-copy tweaks. :sparkles:
